result.instructions: Tools for Freshly Inventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which inventory batches of this product expire in the next 30 days?"; "Show the batches assigned to order 5443815864496, line item 13374776201392."; "Create a batch of 55 units of this variant at our main location, with expiry 2027-03-01.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Freshly Inventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freshly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freshly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freshly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. freshly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freshly_get_shop
tools.title: Get Freshly shop
tools.description: Return the Shopify store this API key belongs to (store name and shopify_domain). Good first call to confirm the key works. Freshly API: GET /api/shopify/shop.

tools.name: freshly_list_inventory_batches
tools.title: List inventory batches
tools.description: List inventory batches (lot tracking) with quantity, received and expiry dates and metadata. Filter by Shopify location or variant, or search by batch name, number, barcode or invoice. Freshly API: GET /api/shopify/inventory_batches.

location_id.description: Shopify location id to filter by.

variant_id.description: Shopify product variant id to filter by.

search.description: Search batch name, batch number, barcode, invoice number, description or product.

tools.name: freshly_get_inventory_batch
tools.title: Get inventory batch
tools.description: Return one inventory batch by its Freshly id. Freshly API: GET /api/shopify/inventory_batches/:id.

tools.name: freshly_list_batch_assignments
tools.title: List batch assignments for an order line
tools.description: List the inventory batches assigned to one Shopify order line item (batch, quantity, assignment id). Freshly API: GET /api/shopify/inventory_batch_order_items.

line_item_id.description: Shopify line item id on that order.

annotations.title: List batch assignments for an order line

tools.name: freshly_create_inventory_batch
tools.title: Create inventory batch
tools.description: Create a new inventory batch of one product variant at one Shopify location. Set enable_shopify_sync true only when the Shopify stock level must change too. Freshly API: POST /api/shopify/inventory_batches.

received_date.description: Date the batch was received, yyyy-mm-dd.

enable_shopify_sync.description: true also applies a Shopify inventory adjustment for this batch. Leave unset to record in Freshly only.

tools.name: freshly_update_inventory_batch
tools.title: Update inventory batch
tools.description: Change fields of one inventory batch (quantity, location, variant, dates or text). Only the fields you pass change. Set enable_shopify_sync true only when the Shopify stock level must change too. Freshly API: PUT /api/shopify/inventory_batches/:id.

received_date.description: Date the batch was received, yyyy-mm-dd.

enable_shopify_sync.description: true also applies a Shopify inventory adjustment for this change. Leave unset to record in Freshly only.

tools.name: freshly_assign_batch_to_line_item
tools.title: Assign batch to order line
tools.description: Assign a quantity of one inventory batch to one Shopify order line item, so Freshly tracks which lot shipped. Freshly API: POST /api/shopify/inventory_batch_order_items.

line_item_id.description: Shopify line item id on that order.

inventory_batch_id.description: Freshly inventory batch id to draw from.

quantity.description: Units of the batch to assign to this line item.

tools.name: freshly_remove_batch_assignment
tools.title: Remove batch assignment from order line
tools.description: Remove one batch assignment from an order line item (the assignment id comes from freshly_list_batch_assignments). Freshly API: DELETE /api/shopify/inventory_batch_order_items/:id.

annotations.title: Remove batch assignment from order line
